evals.prompt: I have an idea: a Slack bot that nudges remote teams to keep shared habits like daily stand-up notes. Take it all the way from validation to a sprint task list in one go.
evals.expected_output: Full chain planned: found-artifacts check, range stages 1-4, preflight of the four chain members, push warning before idea-validator, members invoked in order with file handoffs, one closing summary.
expectations: Reports that no project artifacts exist yet and that the run starts at idea-validator.
Plans stages idea-validator, prd-generator, tad-generator, tasks-generator in that order, ending at tasks.md.
Runs the Dependency Preflight for exactly those four members (install path, then asm list -p claude --json).
Warns that idea-validator commits and pushes without asking before invoking it.
Hands prd-generator and tad-generator the project folder and tasks-generator the prd.md file path.
Does not answer the members' clarifying questions or push confirmations on the user's behalf.
Ends with one summary listing every artifact with an absolute path and status.

evals.prompt: Just validate this idea and write the PRD, then stop: a marketplace where local bakeries sell day-old bread at a discount.
evals.expected_output: Partial range: idea-validator then prd-generator only; tad and tasks marked skipped; preflight covers only the two members in range.
expectations: Sets the stop point at prd-generator and states the range before running.
Preflight checks idea-validator and prd-generator only, not tad-generator or tasks-generator.
Applies the verdict gate to validate.md before prd-generator runs.
Does not invoke tad-generator or tasks-generator.
Closing summary marks tad.md and tasks.md as skipped (outside the range).

evals.prompt: Continue planning the project in evals/files/resume-project. Finish the plan through to tasks.
evals.expected_output: Detects idea.md, validate.md, prd.md; shows them with the Build it verdict; resumes at tad-generator; reuses existing files without regenerating them.
expectations: Shows a found-artifacts table listing idea.md, validate.md and prd.md as present and tad.md, tasks.md as missing.
Names tad-generator as the resume point.
Does not invoke idea-validator or prd-generator and does not modify idea.md, validate.md or prd.md.
Preflight checks only tad-generator and tasks-generator.
Closing summary marks idea.md, validate.md and prd.md as reused.

evals.prompt: Plan out the rest of the project in evals/files/skip-verdict-project: write the PRD, architecture and tasks.
evals.expected_output: Verdict gate reads Skip it from validate.md and stops the chain before prd-generator, asking whether the user wants to override.
expectations: Reads the Quick Verdict in validate.md as Skip it.
Stops before invoking prd-generator and reports the verdict rationale.
Offers an explicit override instead of continuing on its own.
Does not write prd.md, tad.md or tasks.md.
Still emits a closing summary naming why the chain stopped.
